items.headline: Sunnyvale to weigh 192-child preschool at 855 E. Homestead Road
items.summary: The Planning Commission is scheduled to consider a Special Development Permit on Nov. 9 to demolish a vacant commercial building and build a 16,000-square-foot, two-story childcare and preschool for up to 192 children on a 1.11-acre site. The applicant is listed as CASCO of Primrose Schools, and the plans include a new eight-foot masonry wall along the western and part of the southern property lines.

items.headline: Sunnyvale commission to review rewrite of citywide residential parking rules
items.summary: On Nov. 9, the Planning Commission is scheduled to consider forwarding to the City Council an ordinance that would repeal and replace the parking chapter (19.46) of the zoning code. It would also amend the Downtown, Lawrence Station, and El Camino Real specific plan chapters and the Dual Urban Opportunity Housing chapter. A Oct. 26 agenda had listed a request to continue the item to Nov. 9.

items.headline: Historic-listed home at 1391 Washington Street eyed for new ADU and garage
items.summary: The Historical and Landmarks Commission's November 5 agenda listed a public hearing on a recommendation for a 1,200-square-foot detached accessory dwelling unit and a detached 347-square-foot garage (PLN26-00020). The property is on the city's Historic Resource Inventory, and the project is listed as categorically exempt from CEQA as a small new structure.

items.headline: Landmarks commission to pick a member for preservation ordinance consultant panel
items.summary: The November 5 Historical and Landmarks Commission agenda listed selecting one commissioner to serve on the review board that chooses a consultant for the Historic Preservation Ordinance update. The update is the rewrite of the city's rules for protecting historic properties.

items.headline: Cupertino agenda: $11.8M park fund for Finch Avenue property
items.summary: The November 2 City Council agenda listed a budget modification adding $11,825,000 to the Parkland Dedication Fund to purchase the Finch Property at 10480 Finch Avenue. The item was on the consent calendar, which is typically approved in a single motion.

items.headline: Cupertino agenda: $850,000 Caltrans grant for McClellan Road Bridge design
items.summary: The November 2 City Council agenda listed a resolution to accept $850,000 in Caltrans-administered grant funds and award a design contract to Biggs Cardosa Associates, Inc. for up to $1,278,700 for the McClellan Road Bridge Project.

items.headline: Cupertino agenda: study session on updating 2019 Emergency Operations Plan
items.summary: The November 2 City Council agenda listed a study session on proposed updates to the city's 2019 Emergency Operations Plan, the document that guides how Cupertino responds to disasters.

items.headline: Santa Clara City Hall advisory committee takes up building's future options
items.summary: The City Hall Community Advisory Committee's October 29 agenda listed a discussion and public input session on City Hall's existing conditions, facility needs, and future options. Residents could comment in person, by Zoom, or by emailing CityHallCAC@santaclaraca.gov by 10 a.m. the day before.
